title: Pyrotechnic articles

review.classification: The complete civilian maritime hand-held distress article is within the scope of heading 3604 in the official 35460 row. The French stewardship source reports that product type separately. The environmental assessment treats the original finished unit as opaque and does not extend to its manufacture, use, the waste service or other pyrotechnic product groupings.
review.primary_evidence: French Feux à main is a distinct row in both annual market-placement tables, expressed separately in declared numbers and estimated mass. The 2022 values for this category agree across the two official editions. Both reports identify the mass estimate as a product-category average. Treat this as scheme-level accounting only. 2022 annual report p. 7 states that the reporting perimeter broadened from leisure-only to professional and leisure users beginning 1 January 2022. The 2023 stakeholder minutes p. 2 explicitly confirm the abolition of one-for-one take-back. First French placements and collected previously marketed units must be separated by cohort; aggregate ratios cannot be a particular product’s end-of-life probability.
review.readiness: The environmental method is a candidate. A study needs the reporting period and country, responsibility for original French declaration, dated original finished-product and package scope, a verified upstream environmental dataset and linked lot/period records. Mapping acceptance does not qualify a specific supplier, measured study, scientific review or publication.

native_public_reads.use: The original corrugated-box flow specifies 16.6% primary and 83.4% recycled fibre at plant. The actual external box of the study cohort is unverified. The record supports neither a prescribed box composition nor the identity of the sealed reference article.

review.measurement: Use traceable existing measured net mass of original complete sealed articles, exclude ordinary external packaging, and use an independent count. The physical perimeter must cover the actual custodian when the first national event occurs. Independent synthetic check in comparable article counts: unplaced opening 5 and first unplaced receipts 10 equal first French placements 8, outward unplaced transfers 2 and closing 5. Already-placed opening 4, the same 8, genuine old returns 1 and first external receipts of already-placed stock 2 equal onward shipments 7 and closing 8. The eight cancel on consolidation. A first placement while held by a documented third party inside this perimeter can change status with no external movement; a national placement outside it belongs in a disjoint reporting bridge. Old-cohort services at zero new placement retain source units and may be normalized only to independently documented positive original-cohort net mass. The national category average cannot furnish local mass.
review.bilingual_and_projection: Each language has ten individually identified inventory exchanges. Independent readback of the author commit confirms explicit outside-perimeter and later-service protocols, the statutory-population bridge and distinct old-stock returns in both language files and the canonical structured projection. Translator status remains aligned.

sources.role: CPC3 worksheet row 1569 for 35460, HS 3604; classification-only metadata.

For a French stewardship boundary only: Code de l’environnement R543-229(1°) identifies domestic manufacturing, first national introduction/import, paid or free transfer, direct domestic use and the sole-brand reseller rule. Define a bounded product cohort, responsible declarant and applicable date. The first French accounting declaration can differ from a factory release, a sale elsewhere in the EU or downstream shipping. An excluded direct-use branch still belongs in the reconciliation of a broader statutory population. Use this environmental accounting definition only.

ADEME confirms separate producer-reported national market, collection and treatment data, as well as the accredited category 1 stewardship body; aggregate figures are from declarations and cannot independently prove a participant’s lot. Packaging can fall under a separate reporting scheme, and a fee is not a physical exchange. Reconcile physical products, declarant and packaging coverage without using operational material.

HS 2022 nomenclature, heading 36.04 specifically names signalling flares and distinguishes 3604.10 fireworks from 3604.90 other. Use classification metadata only. The UNSD row supports leaf 35460. External packaging, collection service, matches and fireworks have separate identities.

PYRéO 2022 original report p. 7, chapter 3. A separate declared unit row for hand-held distress products and a weight estimate computed using the scheme category mean. This is product-category environmental accounting; it does not measure a selected individual article or the impact of the studied cohort.

PYRéO 2024 original report p. 7, chapter 3. A separate declared unit row for hand-held distress products and a weight estimate computed using the scheme category mean. This is product-category environmental accounting; it does not measure a selected individual article or the impact of the studied cohort.

2023 stakeholder committee minutes p. 2 confirm altered reporting population and the abolition of one-for-one take-back. Consumer waste recovery cannot be inferred from contemporaneous market placements.

Original Decree 2020-1725, Article 7(3°), text replacing Code de l’environnement R543-229(1°). Controller verified the official rendered Journal officiel article, independently of the author’s direct-HTTP 403. Includes paid/free onward provision, direct domestic use, and the sole reseller-brand rule. This PCR may select a narrower onward-supply cohort and document direct-use exclusions.
